title: actaea spicata subsp. rubra
intro: Actaea spicata subsp. rubra, commonly known as American red baneberry, is a plant species in the family Ranunculaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as reducing fever, relieving pain, and treating various skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of American red baneberry include its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antipyretic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
